definitions.explanation: The act or time of being born.
The place where one was born or originated from.
Used to indicate the year of birth.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}{生|う}まれです。
{生|う}まれも{育|そだ}ちも{大阪|おおさか}です。
examples.english: I was born and raised in Osaka.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{生|う}まれが{良|よ}い。
examples.english: He comes from a good family.

examples.japanese: {生|う}まれながらの{才能|さいのう}がある。
{生|う}まれが{違|ちが}っても、{友達|ともだち}になれる。
examples.english: Even if your backgrounds are different, you can become friends.

examples.japanese: {田舎|いなか}{生|う}まれなので、{自然|しぜん}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: Since I was born in the countryside, I love nature.

examples.japanese: あなたは{何年|なんねん}{生|う}まれですか。
examples.english: What year were you born in?

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{年|とし}{生|う}まれの{友達|ともだち}がたくさんいる。
examples.english: I have many friends who were born in the same year.

notes:
{生|う}まれ is the noun form of {生|う}まれる (to be born).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{生|う}まれ (born in ~)
- {生|う}まれも{育|そだ}ちも (born and raised)
- {生|う}まれつき (by nature, innately)
- {生|う}まれ{変|か}わる (to be reborn)

USAGE:
- {東京|とうきょう}{生|う}まれ: Tokyo-born
- 〜{年|ねん}{生|う}まれ: born in ~ year
